creatorDescription: Woman in her mid-20s, dark curly hair in a claw clip, sage-green sweatshirt

shots.prompt: Raw iPhone front-camera selfie video, vertical, constant handheld shake, arm visible at the frame edge, natural late-afternoon window light, not cinematic. <<<element_1>>> sits cross-legged on an unmade bed in her small apartment bedroom wearing an oversized sage-green sweatshirt. She leans toward the lens with a half-laugh, like confessing something embarrassing, and says {says}
shots.says: I thought we were broke growing up because Mom clipped coupons.
shots.caption: I thought we were broke...

shots.prompt: 1998 home video shot on a VHS camcorder: washed-out colors, soft focus, slight tape wobble. Close-up of a mother's hands at a cluttered kitchen table cutting coupons out of a newspaper insert with orange-handled scissors, a small pile of clipped coupons growing, warm tungsten kitchen light. No faces, no dialogue. Sound: scissors snipping, an old fridge humming.
shots.caption: No brand names. Clearance only.

shots.prompt: Raw iPhone front-camera selfie, same bedroom and same window light, handheld shake. <<<element_1>>> pulls the phone closer for a tight close-up, raises her eyebrows with a knowing smile, and says {says}
shots.says: Turns out we weren't broke. We were saving.
shots.caption: Not broke. Saving.

shots.prompt: Magical slow-motion shot in a warm sunbeam: dozens of paper coupons swirl upward and transform mid-air into glowing golden tickets, sparkling light trails, dreamy and surreal. No people, no dialogue, no readable text. Sound: a soft shimmering whoosh.

Raw iPhone front-camera selfie in the same bedroom, handheld shake. Small glowing golden tickets now float in the air around <<<element_1>>>, catching the window light. She grins at the lens and says {says}
shots.says: Now Lodavo gives you free tickets for saving.
shots.caption: Free tickets. Just for saving.

lines: A chance to win cash every week.
